title: Our History
subtitle: Legacy of Excellence Since 1952
journeyText: Shree Saraswati Secondary School began its journey in the Gurukul era of 1995, when education was imparted with only a few students and teachers, yet there was no compromise on learning, discipline, or values. This humble beginning laid a strong foundation for knowledge, character, and holistic development. Building on this tradition, the school was officially established in 2016, bringing together modern education and the time-tested Gurukul principles. From its early days to today, the school has remained committed to nurturing curiosity, excellence, and leadership in every student.
